hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Prediction market hook implementing VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity System) fees. Requires a backend-signed sigma parameter per swap; fees are calculated as e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ] and routed to share token holders via a YieldDistributor rather than to LPs. Blocks swaps when the market is resolved or disputed. Tracks LP virtual balances and updates YES/NO share token prices after each swap.
